# EMMana-Next rev30 — unified antenna templates

- Added registry-driven physical parameter panel.
- Added implemented 5/7-element Yagi seeds and experimental Moxon seed.
- Dipole, GP, 3/5/7 Yagi, square loop and Moxon use the same UI/backend parameter contract.
- Generated result remains pure EMNX.
- Existing manual 2D/3D geometry editing, Undo/Redo, A/B/C and optimizer remain available.
- 5/7 Yagi and Moxon are experimental; no new trust claim was added.
- Solver physics and EMNX schemas are unchanged.
